prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: uart-tx-div
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 8f5f27ebbae8a5e7
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback TX stayed idle so ser_tx=1 and RX got 0xff vs want 0xa5 at TRAP: uart data mismatch got 0xff want 0xa5. With divider 64 from picosoc/picosoc.v:120 and picosoc/picosoc.v:197 reg_div_we path, TX bit timer at picosoc/simpleuart.v:130 uses (cfg_divider >> 4) making TX ~16x too fast, so the RX sampler misses the start/data bits and reads idle. Fix is to use full cfg_divider for the TX bit period.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 8f5f27ebbae8a5e7 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
